hybrid.review_body:
What Is Adstorm Elite?

Adstorm is an AI-powered ad creative tool from Cyril Gupta (Teknikforce) that generates complete advertisements — copy and visuals — for 29+ ad formats across Facebook, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and X. It launches on JVZoo on May 22, 2026 at $47 one-time during the 7-day launch window, after which it moves to recurring pricing.

The core premise is simple: paste a URL or describe your offer, pick your platform and format, click generate. You get a finished ad — not a half-built template that needs hours of editing.

Who Made It?

Cyril Gupta (also known as Cyril Jeet) runs Teknikforce, one of the more credible software companies in the IM launch space. His track record includes CloudFunnels ($500K+ revenue), Tuberank Jeet AI ($470K+), Livecaster ($400K+), and a dozen other products with consistent 4-figure to 6-figure launch results. His products have a reputation for staying alive post-launch — an important point given how many JVZoo tools disappear within a year.

What Does It Actually Do?

Adstorm handles the ad creative workflow end-to-end. You don't get headlines on one side and a separate image generator on the other — you get one output that's ready to drop into your ad platform. The tool supports text ads, image ads, and video ads, which puts it ahead of tools that only cover static creatives.

The competitor ad adaptation feature is the standout for me. Being able to paste a competitor's ad or landing page and get an adapted version removes the cold-start problem that kills most ad campaigns. Instead of guessing what hooks work in your niche, you start from something that's already converting.

Front-End Limitations to Know

The $47 FE isn't unlimited. You get 20,000 credits, 15 ads per day, and 4 campaigns. The advanced AI models are locked behind OTO1 (Pro). For personal campaigns this is workable. For agencies or anyone running multiple client accounts simultaneously, you'll hit the ceiling and need to upgrade.

Commercial license is also OTO1 only — the FE doesn't allow you to resell ad work to clients. That's worth knowing before you plan to build a service around it.

The Funnel

Four OTOs: Pro (removes most FE limits, adds commercial license), Reseller (sell your own Adstorm licenses), TubeTarget Pro (YouTube targeting), and Adplify Pro (Facebook ad intelligence). The FE stands alone for personal use. The OTOs are meaningful upgrades — none of them feel like artificial gates on features that should have been included in the base price.

Bottom Line

Adstorm fills a real gap: most AI tools handle copy OR visuals, not both, and almost none of them produce platform-native formats. The 3-click workflow and 29+ format library make this useful for anyone running paid traffic who doesn't want to manage a designer and copywriter separately. The FE limits are real but manageable for individual users. At $47 one-time before it goes recurring, the price makes the decision easy.
